senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be crushed; to be low, sink; to be poor. Tanḥ. B’har 3 על שמָךְ בעונות because he sank into sins.—V. מָךְ.

<cite ref="M00469">same</cite>. Mekh. B’shall., Amal., s. 1 <he>כשהוא מֵמִיךְ ידיו עתידין ישראל להָמִיךְ ול׳</he> when he (Moses) let his hands sink, (it intimated) that Israel is destined to sink in the knowledge of the words of the Law to be given through his hands; Tanḥ.
to lower, let sink. Ib., v. supra.—
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 90:1">Sifré Num. 90</cite> <he>כאן הקב״ה ממיך ומשה מגביה וכ׳</he> here the Lord lowers (his anger) and Moses raises (is more angry), but when the golden calf was made, the Lord raised, and Moses lowered (tried to soften his anger); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 735:11">Yalk. Num. 735</cite> <he>מַמְאִיךְ</he> (fr. <cite ref="M00035"><he>מָאַךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 4:7">Kil. IV, 7</cite> <he>נ׳ מי׳ טפחים</he> lower than ten handbreadths.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 5:12">Ruth R. to III, 3</cite> <he>בנ׳ שבעיר</he> in the lowest part of the city. Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 56ᵈ; Y. Sot. IX, 24ᵃ bot. <he>קול נ׳</he> in a low voice, opp. <cite ref="C00053"><he>גבוה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:19">Ab. V, 19</cite> <he>רוח נְ׳</he> a lowly spirit, v. <cite ref="C00053"><he>גָּבוֹהַּ</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>ההרים הנ׳</he> the lower mountains; a. fr.
